title: symbolic user functions: flat evaluation of the scalar expressions, with the compiled list as text
author: Claude-JG
description: The recorded graph of a symbolic user function is sorted once into a list of operations, evaluated into slots that belong to one evaluation; tree evaluation stays as reference and fallback, a test shows both bit-identical; the compiled list can be exported as text; userRigidBodyTest.py with 10000 steps measured before and after. Scalar results and vector and matrix results built from scalar components first.
releaseNotes: Symbolic user functions whose result is a number, or a vector or matrix of numbers, are evaluated by a list of operations built after the recording, each shared value once per call; GetFlatProgram() gives the list as text, flatEvaluation=False the tree evaluation (revision2026c step RG12.2.6)
